svg.title: 1xLoZec Detection Engineering Lab — Tall Kitchen architecture
svg.desc: Top: network topology — threat sources feed an Elastic SIEM. Bottom: Tall Kitchen, the two-pillar assistant for cyber security professionals. Water writes Sigma detection rules continuously with self-healing validation. Hunt enriches IOCs from seven sources and remembers every investigation.
svg.text: A cybersecurity lab that catches real attackers, and the tool I built to run it.
Built by one person and a stack of AI platforms working together. The design and decisions are mine. The typing speed is theirs.
Cloud server pretending to be a vulnerable target.
Real attackers from the internet attack it. We watch.
Virtual machines I use to test attacks safely
and collect telemetry from real operating systems.
Where I run bad stuff on purpose so I can
see what it looks like in the SIEM.
The brain of the lab. Every event from every source lands here, gets indexed,
searched, alerted on, and shown on dashboards. Tall Kitchen reads from it.
Tall Kitchen is an assistant I built for Cyber Security professionals.
Water writes the detection rules. Hunt runs the lookups.
Cuts the busywork. Keeps the judgment in your hands.
Water watches the lab all the time. When it sees something that
looks like a real attack pattern, it writes a detection rule for it

text.tspan: Three different AIs grade every rule before it goes live.

svg.text: If one fails it, Water rewrites it and tries again. If it keeps
failing, Water stops and emails me. I wake up to new rules
The work that used to take a senior engineer a full
afternoon happens overnight while nobody's watching.
Hunt takes an IP, a domain, or a file hash and tells me
everything about it in one command. Where it came from.
Who owns it. What to look at next.
Hunt remembers every search I've ever done, so if I
look something up again I see my old notes and how the
answer changed. If Hunt doesn't know something,
it tells me it doesn't know instead of making something up.
One command replaces twelve tabs and twenty
minutes of senior analyst time per alert.
BUILT IN PUBLIC · DOCUMENTED IN REAL TIME
